title: Graded-split short exact sequences of right DG modules
statement: Work in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. For an associative unital differential graded integer algebra $A$ and right differential graded modules $K,L,M$ as in [def-sfb-dg-derived-category], a graded-split short exact sequence consists of DG maps $i:K\to L$, $v:L\to M$ which in every integer degree are respectively injective and surjective and satisfy $\ker v=\operatorname{im}i$, together with additive maps $s^n:M^n\to L^n$ such that $v^n s^n=1$ and $s^{n+m}(xa)=s^n(x)a$ for every homogeneous $x\in M^n$, $a\in A^m$. The section has degree zero and preserves the right $A$-action; it need not commute with the differentials. This is an admissible short exact sequence with its chosen graded splitting.
